# aj meta

Site-wide lists: statuses, priorities, resolutions, issue types.


## `aj meta statuses`

List every status and its category.

```text
aj meta statuses [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--json` |  | Print JSON. |
| `--csv` |  | Print CSV. |


## `aj meta priorities`

List priorities.

```text
aj meta priorities [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--json` |  | Print JSON. |
| `--csv` |  | Print CSV. |


## `aj meta resolutions`

List resolutions.

```text
aj meta resolutions [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--json` |  | Print JSON. |
| `--csv` |  | Print CSV. |


## `aj meta issue-types`

List issue types.

```text
aj meta issue-types [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-p`, `--project` `TEXT` |  | Only this project's types. |
| `--json` |  | Print JSON. |
| `--csv` |  | Print CSV. |
